job:
workflow-security:
    name: Workflow Security
    if: inputs.run-workflow-security
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@1d88384fd173af6ecb012dfd0264a306b711241a # v2.22.4
        with:
          egress-policy: ${{ inputs.workflow-security-egress-policy }}
          allowed-endpoints: ${{ inputs.workflow-security-allowed-endpoints }}

      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run zizmor
        uses: zizmorcore/zizmor-action@45d7276c9ca790aabd705e31ca99c6185c3e76dd # v0.8.1
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          advanced-security: false
          online-audits: false
